children: A Vanguard executive said on Friday the asset manager intends to invest over the coming years approximately $2.5 billion in Vietnam as the country moves to emerging market status.

"Vanguard plans to hold Vietnam exposure for decades as long as it's in the benchmark," Duncan Burns, its Asia-Pacific head of investment management and global equity, told a conference in Hanoi ahead of the country's upgrade to emerging status by index provider FTSE Russell next week.
